summary: Live for Speed is a long-running PC racing simulator with a license-tier model, wheel/force-feedback focus, multiplayer, and an actively updated official client.

entries.title: Live for Speed
entries.definitive_edition: Current official Windows client with license tier documented

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current official LFS client with exact setup/license state documented

primary.version: Current official LFS client with S3 license state documented
primary.why: Live for Speed is a PC-first simulation built around its own official client and license tiers. The current official download is the practical route, but archive notes need license tier, physics/client version, car/track access, wheel setup, and online state.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current client from lfs.net. Record version, license tier, car/track, wheel/controller and force-feedback settings, assists, online/server state, setup file, replay state, and whether mods/custom content were used.

all_releases.reason: primary: only official platform route and current access path.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record license tier and client version; do not substitute other sim racers.
